multi_hop.question: How can an LLM serving system reuse previously computed attention state, and along which structural dimensions — a conversation's earlier exchanges versus the model's internal attention components — have recent systems found reuse opportunities?
multi_hop.rationale: Tangram exploits non-uniform KV cache across turns; RedKnot does head-aware KV reuse. Answer requires both.
titles: Tangram: Unlocking Non-Uniform KV Cache for Efficient Multi-turn LLM Serving
RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention

multi_hop.question: When many specialized language models are available, how do lightweight closed-form methods for deciding which model should answer a prompt compare with approaches that learn routing from user preferences balancing quality against expense?
multi_hop.rationale: IR3DE is the linear router; the HKUST paper meta-learns from implicit cost-performance preferences. Comparison needs both.
titles: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
Learning to Route LLMs from Implicit Cost-Performance Preferences via Meta-Learning

multi_hop.question: As conversational agents accumulate long-term memories over many sessions, how do recent systems organize what they remember, and how do they cope with stored facts that later turn out to conflict with each other?
multi_hop.rationale: TokenMizer organizes session memory as a graph; TOKI resolves contradictions with a bitemporal operator algebra.
titles: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
TOKI: A Bitemporal Operator Algebra for Contradiction Resolution in LLM-Agent Persistent Memory

multi_hop.question: Transformers often treat information differently depending on where it sits in the input. What explains a decoder-only model's implicit sense of token location, and how can adjusting the strength of location signals at different depths reduce unevenness in attention?
multi_hop.rationale: One paper analyzes the origin of absolute position; the other intervenes on positional embeddings layer-by-layer.
titles: Where does Absolute Position come from in decoder-only Transformers?
Mitigating Position Bias in Transformers via Layer-Specific Positional Embedding Scaling

multi_hop.question: How can provable robustness guarantees be extended from classifiers to systems that transcribe spoken audio, and what techniques reduce the computational cost of producing such guarantees?
multi_hop.rationale: Same research group: one extends certification to ASR, the other accelerates certification via early stopping.
titles: What Was That Again? Certified Robustness for Automatic Speech Recognition
Halt Fast! Early Stopping for Certified Robustness

multi_hop.question: Some language models reason in continuous hidden space rather than emitting word-by-word chains of thought. What approaches make such internal reasoning more reliable — invertible density modeling of the latent trajectory versus verifying reconstructions at inference time?
multi_hop.rationale: Two different mechanisms applied to the same emerging area (latent reasoning).
titles: Latent Reasoning with Normalizing Flows
Closing the Loop on Latent Reasoning via Test-Time Reconstruction

multi_hop.question: When learning systems exploit loopholes in their objective instead of solving the intended task, how is this failure detected inside language-model agents, compared with how it is prevented in cooperative control of physical systems such as turbulent flows?
multi_hop.rationale: Mechanistic monitoring of reward-hack activations in LLM agents vs. reward design in fluid-control MARL.
titles: From Reward-Hack Activations to Agentic Risk States: Context-Calibrated Mechanistic Monitoring in LLM Agents
Drag reduction or reward hacking? Recurrent multi-agent reinforcement learning that earns its reward

multi_hop.question: Dictionary-learning methods that decompose a network's activations into sparse features can be hard to interpret. How can their interpretability be improved during training itself, versus by assigning human-readable names to the learned directions afterwards?
multi_hop.rationale: Train-time (subspace-aware SAEs) vs post-hoc (VASAE naming) interpretability for the same artifact class.
titles: Subspace-Aware Sparse Autoencoders for Effective Mechanistic Interpretability
VASAE: Naming SAE Dictionary Directions with Vocabulary-Aligned Anchoring

multi_hop.question: For forecasting ship movements from historical tracking data, how do models that consult stored examples of past motion patterns differ from probabilistic approaches that place priors over continuous-time dynamics?
multi_hop.rationale: Same task and overlapping author group, two modeling philosophies (memory vs Bayesian dynamics).
titles: AIS-Based Vessel Trajectory Prediction Using Memory-Augmented Neural Networks
Function-Space Priors for Bayesian Neural ODEs with Application to Vessel Trajectory Prediction

multi_hop.question: Parallel text generation via iterative denoising still trails left-to-right generation in quality. What remedies have been proposed — restructuring how context is attended to during parallel decoding, versus pulling in external documents to guide generation?
multi_hop.rationale: Bifocal dLLMs change the context mechanism; self-augmenting retrieval adds external evidence. Both target dLLM quality.
titles: Bifocal Diffusion Language Models: Asymmetric Bidirectional Context for Parallel Generation
Self-Augmenting Retrieval for Diffusion Language Models

multi_hop.question: To speed up long-context decoding, some systems attend to only a subset of tokens. How do designs that make one token-selection decision and share it across the network compare with serving frameworks that let each workload customize its own sparsity pattern?
multi_hop.rationale: You Only Index Once shares cross-layer routing; Vortex makes sparse attention programmable for agent serving.
titles: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents

multi_hop.question: When a model's built-in knowledge disagrees with evidence supplied at inference time — retrieved text or an input image — how does the model decide which side to trust, and what interventions can steer that choice?
multi_hop.rationale: SHIFT steers activations for RAG knowledge conflict; the VLM paper traces causal mechanisms of perception-knowledge conflict.
titles: Shift: Gate-Modulated Activation Steering for Knowledge Conflict Mitigation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Vision-Default, Prior-Override: Causal Mechanisms of Perception-Knowledge Conflict in Vision-Language Models
